description: Generate an image from a text prompt with Obscurify.ai's Stable Diffusion image models (SDXL, SD 1.5 and LCM checkpoints). Returns the image. Costs a fraction of a cent per image from the account balance. Pass `list: true` to see the available image models and prices instead.

list.description: List image models and prices instead of generating.

model.description: Image model ID (default "realvis-xl-v4", photorealistic). Others include "juggernaut-xl-v10" and "animagine-xl-v-3-1" (anime). Use list: true for all.

negative_prompt.description: Things to keep out of the image.

prompt.description: What to draw. Required unless list is true.

name: generate_image
title: Generate an image
